name: Disneyland Carnation Cafe Classic Mickey-Shaped Waffles & Scrambled Eggs
whyItWorks: Crisp, golden malted Mickey-shaped waffles paired with soft scrambled eggs and pure maple syrup. Completely seed-free, zero roughage, and highly digestible park fuel.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Mickey Waffles breakfast with scrambled eggs and bacon (or fruit cup with peeled melon).
